css.name: --ok-font-family
css.value: "Public Sans Variable", "Public Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

events.description: The user asked to collapse a node. `preventDefault()` keeps it expanded.
events.name: ok:organization-chart:collapse

events.description: The user asked to expand a node (its toggle, or its label with `data-ok-expand-collapse-on-node-click`). `preventDefault()` keeps it collapsed.
events.name: ok:organization-chart:expand

events.description: A node whose children list is empty is expanding for the first time. Call `respondWith(nodesOrPromise)` with its child nodes (`li[data-ok-organization-chart-node]` elements, for example cloned from a `template`). No nodes make it a leaf; a rejected promise keeps it collapsed, and the next expand asks again.
events.detail: { nodeId: string | null; node: HTMLElement; respondWith(nodes: PromiseLike<OrganizationChartLoadedNodes> | OrganizationChartLoadedNodes): void; }
events.name: ok:organization-chart:loadchildren

events.description: The user asked for another zoom level (Ctrl or Command with the wheel, a pinch, the + / − / 0 keys or the toolbar; `data-ok-enable-zoom-pan`). `preventDefault()` keeps the current level.
events.name: ok:organization-chart:zoom

methods.description: Scrolls the chart's scroll area so the node with this `data-ok-node-id` is centered, after expanding its collapsed ancestors. Resolves once the scroll starts.
methods.name: centerOnNode

methods.description: Collapses every node, the root included.
methods.name: collapseAll

methods.description: Collapses a node and every node under it.
methods.name: collapseSubtree

methods.description: Expands the node with this `data-ok-node-id`, loading its children first when needed. Resolves once done.
methods.name: expand

methods.description: Expands every node whose children are loaded.
methods.name: expandAll

methods.description: Expands a node and every loaded node under it.
methods.name: expandSubtree

methods.description: Expands the nodes above `depth` (the root is depth 0) and collapses the others.
methods.name: expandToDepth

methods.description: The largest level up to 100% at which the whole chart fits its scroll area, then scrolls to its start.
methods.name: fitScreen

methods.description: The `data-ok-node-id` of the highlighted node, or `null`.
methods.name: getHighlightedNode

methods.description: Highlights the node with this `data-ok-node-id` and its path to the root (`data-ok-highlighted`, the others fade), expands its collapsed ancestors and scrolls it into view. Resolves once it is in view. Replaces an earlier highlight.
methods.name: highlightNode

methods.description: Whether the node with this `data-ok-node-id` shows its children.
methods.name: isExpanded

methods.description: Sets the zoom level (1 is 100%), within `data-ok-min-zoom` and `data-ok-max-zoom`.
methods.name: setZoom

methods.description: Multiplies the zoom level by `1 + factor`: positive zooms in, negative zooms out.
methods.name: zoom

options.description: Where the root sits: `top` (default, children below), `bottom`, `left` (at the inline start) or `right`.
options.name: direction

options.description: Height of the connectors between two levels: a number in px, or a CSS length.
options.name: lineHeight

options.description: Thickness of the connectors: a number in px, or a CSS length.
options.name: lineWidth

options.description: `divider` (default), `inherit` (the text color) or a palette color (its light tone).
options.name: lineColor

options.description: Line style of the connectors.
options.name: lineStyle

options.description: `default`: a node's own `lineColor` and `lineStyle` style the lines to its children only. `node`: they style its whole branch, down to the nodes that set their own.
options.name: edgeColorMode

options.description: Corner radius where a connector turns: a number in px, or a CSS length.
options.name: lineBorderRadius

options.description: Space on each side of every node: a number in px, or a CSS length.
options.name: nodePadding

options.description: Two or more children without children of their own stack in one column, joined to their parent by a line along their side.
options.name: groupLeafNodes

options.description: Space between grouped leaf nodes: a number in px, or a CSS length.
options.name: groupLeafNodesSpacing

options.description: Nodes with children can be collapsed and expanded with their toggle button.
options.name: enableExpandCollapse

options.description: A click on a node's label (outside its buttons and links) also toggles its children.
options.name: expandCollapseOnNodeClick

options.description: Smallest number of hidden descendants that a collapsed node's badge shows.
options.name: collapseBadgeThreshold

options.description: Hovering or focusing a node highlights its path to the root and dims the other nodes.
options.name: highlightOnHover

options.description: How much nodes outside a highlighted path fade, from 0 (not at all) to 1 (hidden).
options.name: dimOpacity

options.description: Ctrl or Command with the mouse wheel, a trackpad pinch, the + / − / 0 keys and the toolbar zoom the chart; a mouse drag pans it.
options.name: enableZoomPan

options.description: The zoom level, from `minZoom` to `maxZoom` (1 is 100%). Changed by the user with zoom and pan on.
options.name: zoom

options.description: The smallest zoom level.
options.name: minZoom

options.description: The largest zoom level.
options.name: maxZoom

parts.description: On a node: it is highlighted (a search result). Its path to the root keeps its colors while the other nodes fade. Written by `highlightNode(id)`.
parts.name: data-ok-highlighted

parts.description: On a node: its id, used by the instance methods and in the events.
parts.name: data-ok-node-id

parts.description: In a toggle: the number of hidden descendants, written by the script while the node is collapsed. Leave it out for no badge.
parts.name: data-ok-organization-chart-badge

parts.description: The list of a node's children. Absent without children; empty and `hidden` on a node whose children load on demand.
parts.name: data-ok-organization-chart-children

parts.description: In the toolbar: fits the whole chart in its scroll area, up to 100%.
parts.name: data-ok-organization-chart-fit

parts.description: A node's content, such as a card.
parts.name: data-ok-organization-chart-label

parts.description: In a toggle: the loading indicator of a node whose children load on demand, shown while the toggle is `aria-busy`.
parts.name: data-ok-organization-chart-spinner

parts.description: The button after a label that expands and collapses the node's children (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`).
parts.name: data-ok-organization-chart-toggle

parts.description: The chevron icon of a toggle.
parts.name: data-ok-organization-chart-toggle-icon

parts.description: The toggle's name, visually hidden, such as "Priya Raman's reports". The badge's count follows it in the name.
parts.name: data-ok-organization-chart-toggle-label

parts.description: In the toolbar: zooms in by one step. `aria-disabled` at the largest level.
parts.name: data-ok-organization-chart-zoom-in

parts.description: In the toolbar: zooms out by one step. `aria-disabled` at the smallest level.
parts.name: data-ok-organization-chart-zoom-out

parts.description: In the toolbar: the zoom level as a percentage, written by the script and announced politely.
parts.name: data-ok-organization-chart-zoom-value

parts.description: On the chart: set while a mouse drag pans its scroll area.
parts.name: data-ok-panning
